did: Built Studio's Episodes as design A, by week. Every genre's episodes sit in one feed grouped by week, under genre chips with counts. Each row has a stock drawing per genre and a status dot from a shared dot table in @some-ui/shared. A call's parts show inline. Home's new date and length fields are read. The interview essay is added as a genre. A pure model and words table are held by tests, and a ui-fit spec checks the phone's sizes.
